# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository-level [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). It contains the current
Angular commands, repository structure, product guardrails, and validation expectations.

The prior instructions in this file predated the application and are no longer valid.
In particular, `src/` contains the Angular source and `docs/` contains generated GitHub
Pages output; do not hand-edit `docs/` or place planning documents there.
